entities.summary: Sant'Andrea a San Donnino is a Roman Catholic parish church in the San Donnino neighborhood of the town limits of Campi Bisenzio, located on the Via Pistoiese just west of Florence, in the region of Tuscany, Italy. Adjacent to the church is a small art Museum. Church of St. Andrew in San Donnino is a church building in Europe. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
